description: This file contains functions and constants for truncating tool result messages to fit within model context limits, including session-based truncation and in-memory message truncation, with heuristics for important tail content and size calculations.

methods.name: hasImportantTail
methods.description: Detects if the text likely contains error or diagnostic content near the end that should be preserved during truncation.

methods.name: truncateToolResultText
methods.description: Truncates a string to fit within maxChars, using head+tail strategy if important tail content is detected.

methods.name: calculateMaxToolResultChars
methods.description: Calculates maximum allowed characters for a tool result based on context window tokens.

methods.name: getToolResultTextLength
methods.description: Returns total character count of text content blocks in a tool result message.

methods.name: truncateToolResultMessage
methods.description: Truncates a tool result message's text content blocks to fit within maxChars, returning a new message.

methods.name: truncateOversizedToolResultsInSession
methods.description: Finds and truncates oversized tool results in a session file, updating the session transcript.

methods.name: truncateOversizedToolResultsInMessages
methods.description: Pre-emptively truncates oversized tool result messages in-memory, returning a new array.

methods.name: isOversizedToolResult
methods.description: Checks if a tool result message exceeds size limit for given context window.

methods.name: sessionLikelyHasOversizedToolResults
methods.description: Heuristic to estimate if session has oversized tool results causing context overflow.
